description: Specification of all Inno Setup script sections, their attributes and flags used by the plugin for completion, validation and documentation.

sections.description: List of all script sections (e.g. [Setup], [Files], [Code]) supported by the plugin.

section.description: A single Inno Setup script section, identified by its header name and the kind of content it accepts.

name.description: Section header name as written in the script without brackets (e.g. "Setup", "Files").

type.description: Structural kind of the section: "directive" for Key=Value sections, "parameter" for Key: Value parameter lists, or "code" for the Pascal [Code] section.

deprecated.description: Whether this section is deprecated and should no longer be used in new scripts.

required.description: Whether this section must be present in every valid Inno Setup script.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the section's purpose, shown in documentation and tooltips.

attributes.description: List of keys or parameters that may appear inside this section.

internationalization.description: Whether keys in this section may carry a language prefix (e.g. "en.MessageName"); enables language-prefix completion. Applies to [Messages] and [CustomMessages]. Defaults to false.

since.description: Inno Setup version in which this section was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup version up to which this section is supported; absent if still current.

attribute.description: A single key (directive section) or parameter (parameter section) that can be set within a section.

name.description: Name of the key or parameter as written in the script (e.g. "AppName", "Source").

type.description: Value type of the attribute, defining how its value is parsed and validated.

required.description: Whether this attribute must be specified within its section.

deprecated.description: Whether this attribute is deprecated and should no longer be used in new scripts.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the attribute's purpose, shown in documentation and tooltips.

array.description: Whether the attribute accepts multiple values, e.g. a space- or comma-separated list of flags.

since.description: Inno Setup version in which this attribute was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup version up to which this attribute is supported; absent if still current.

attributeType.description: Discriminated union describing how an attribute's value is typed: a native primitive, a reference to another section, or a set of flags.

oneOf.description: A primitive value such as a string, boolean or integer.

kind.description: Discriminator selecting the native primitive value type.

dataType.description: Concrete primitive data type expected for the attribute value.

oneOf.description: A value that references an entry defined in another section (e.g. a component or task name).

kind.description: Discriminator selecting the cross-section reference value type.

section.description: Name of the section whose entries this attribute value refers to (e.g. "Components", "Tasks").

oneOf.description: A value made up of one or more predefined flag keywords.

kind.description: Discriminator selecting the flag-set value type.

flags.description: List of flag keywords that are valid for this attribute.

flagEntry.description: A single flag keyword that may be used in a flags-typed attribute.

name.description: Flag keyword as written in the script (e.g. "ignoreversion", "recursesubdirs").

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the flag does, shown in documentation and tooltips.

deprecated.description: Whether this flag is deprecated and should no longer be used in new scripts.

conflicts.description: Other flags that cannot be combined with this flag, each with a type.

items.description: A single conflicting flag together with how severe the conflict is.

flag.description: Name of the conflicting flag keyword.

type.description: Type of flag conflict. Depends on type an annotator mark this flag as superfluous because the declaring flag already implies it (or nullifies its effect).

since.description: Inno Setup version in which this flag was introduced (e.g. "6.0.0").

until.description: Inno Setup version up to which this flag is supported; absent if still current.
